response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or embedded systems, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 2014 role at National Instruments; the overwhelming focus is on JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies, with no evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial protocols required for the role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse domains and languages
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and build dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development experience beyond 2015
Absence of industrial automation, IoT, or secure coding standards (IEC 62443) experience
No demonstrable use of STL, networking, multi-threading, or MQTT/REST in industrial context
